_note: What you see: How the team is doing: counters for open, overdue, completed, my tasks and within deadline; cases by status and by type; stuck cases, followed cases and recently opened.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Hoe het team ervoor staat: tellers voor open, te laat, afgehandeld, mijn taken en binnen termijn; zaken per status en per type; vastgelopen (met de regel van zeven dagen), gevolgde zaken en recent geopend. Derde rij: mijn open werk, de wachtrij van uw teams, termijnsignalen (te laat en risico, met verstreken termijn), taakherinneringen; het paneel Woo-termijnen; widgets schikken en de eigen indeling; welke widgets een rol verbergt; dezelfde twee widgets op het Nextcloud-dashboard. Bij de tegels: de lege standen Geen open zaken en Geen termijnsignalen.
oktober 2026, alle teams waar u in zit: October 2026, all teams you are in
uw eigen indeling van de widgets wordt b: your own arrangement of the widgets is kept; anyone who has not moved anything sees the arrangement the manifest ships
haalden hun termijn, naar doorlooptijd: met their deadline, by lead time
Klik een balk om de zaken te zien: Click a bar to see the cases
Zeven dagen of langer zonder update, lan: Seven days or longer without an update, longest first. Bezwaar omgevingsvergunning, updated three days ago, is not listed. Without such cases the card reads: No stalled cases.
Zaken en taken, eerst wat het eerst moet: Cases and tasks, soonest due first
na zes regels telt de kaart de rest: after six rows the card counts the rest
Opgepakt door niemand, in de teams waar: Picked up by nobody, in the teams you are in
De zaak van team Toezicht staat er niet:: The case of team Toezicht is not listed: you are not in that team. If you are in no team, the card reads: you are in no team, ask your administrator, and requests nothing.
Te laat, en minder dan een kwart van de: Overdue, and less than a quarter of the deadline left
Minste dagen eerst. Een zaak met 5 dagen: Fewest days first. A case with 5 of 56 days left is not listed. The bar is the time consumed.
Taken die vandaag of binnen drie dagen m: Tasks due today or within three days
Advies vragen aan Mobiliteit en verkeer: Request advice from Mobility and traffic
Te laat bovenaan, meeste dagen eerst; da: Overdue on top, most days first; then by date. A task due in five days is not listed. Without tasks the card reads: No task reminders.
Alle lopende Woo-verzoeken op dagen tot: Every open Woo request by days to the decision date, fewest first
Rood: te laat. Oranje: twee dagen of min: Red: overdue. Orange: two days or less. Yellow: a week or less. Green: on track. The requester is shown when known. Without open Woo requests the card reads: No open Woo requests, without an error.
Binnen termijn ziet alleen wie controlee: Only reviewers and administrators see Within deadline. A widget whose role you do not hold is not shown, not even as an empty slot, and the page does not send its data. If a role resolves to nobody, the widget disappears and the log names the widget and the role.
De drie dichtstbijzijnde termijnen; klik: The three nearest deadlines; clicking opens the advice inbox, filtered on your department. Per department this also shows the average response time, the percentage on time and the outcomes (positive, negative, with conditions); a department above 20% overdue is in red.
In Alle zaken filtert u op Mijlpaal: Doc: In All cases you filter on Milestone: Documents complete (reached) or (not reached).
dezelfde twee widgets, te kiezen onder A: the same two widgets, selectable under Customize on the Nextcloud dashboard; the header opens this dashboard, a task opens the task in Dossiq
Meer tegels en hun lege standen: More tiles and their empty states
De lege standen van Zaken per type en Te: The empty states of Cases by type and Deadline alerts, the complaints tile of the case type Complaint, and what Recently opened says when there is nothing to show.
In plaats van de grafiek, zolang geen en: In place of the chart, while no case is open.
Geen zaak nadert of overschrijdt een ter: No case is nearing or past a term.
Bejegening · termijn 6 nov, nog 2 werkda: Conduct · deadline 6 Nov, 2 working days left
KL-2026-0091 Afhandeling melding wegdek: KL-2026-0091 Handling of road surface report
Dit platform houdt niet bij wanneer u ee: This platform does not track when you opened a case. The tile stays empty.
Meld u aan om te zien wat u recent opend: Sign in to see what you opened recently
De tegel leest uw eigen leesmomenten; zo: The tile reads your own reading moments; without signing in there are none.
Recent geopend is nu niet beschikbaar: Recently opened is not available right now
OpenRegister antwoordde niet. Probeer he: OpenRegister did not answer. Try again later; Favourites keeps working.
Met gegevens toont de tegel per zaak wan: With data the tile shows per case when you last opened it, as today or yesterday; it leads to the chip Recently opened in All cases.
Als adviezen bij één adviesinstantie bli: When advice requests pile up at one advisory body, the coordinator gets this signal
Welstandscommissie: 8 verlopen adviezen,: Design review committee: 8 overdue advice requests, average lead time up to 25 days
Vorige maand was dat 10 dagen. De dageli: Last month it was 10 days. The daily analysis also sent this signal as a Nextcloud notification.
